questions.q:
Consider the following system of questions

αx+2y+z=1

2αx+3y+z=1

3x+αy+2z=β

For some α,β∈ℝ. Then which of the following is NOT correct.
options: It has no solution for <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></math> and for all <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">ℝ</mi></math>

It has no solution for <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></math> and for all <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>2</mn></math>

It has a solution for all <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><mo>≠</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math>
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
Given,

System of questions

αx+2y+z=1

2αx+3y+z=1

3x+αy+2z=β

Now finding, D=α212α313α2=0

⇒α(6-α)-2(4α-3)+1(2α2-9)=0

⇒α-3(α+1)=0

⇒α=-1,3

Dx=211311α2β=0⇒β=2

⇒2β-2-1(3β-α)+(6-α)=0

⇒β=2

Dy=α112α1132β=0

⇒α(β-2)-1(2αβ-3)+1(4α-3)=0

⇒α(2-β)=0

⇒α=0,β=2

Dz=α212α313αβ=0

⇒α2-αβ-3=0

Now when β=2,α=-1 the system of equations will have infinite solutions,

When α=3, β=2 the system has infinite solution,

And when α=3, β≠2 the system has no solution as Dx & Dy≠0 for β≠2,

Hence, only option B is not correct

questions.q:
If the system of linear equations,
x+y+z=6
x+2y+3z=10
3x+2y+λz=μ
has more than two solutions, then μ-λ2, is equal to.
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
x+y+z=6  ...1
x+2y+3z=10  ...2
3x+2y+λz=μ  …3

From 1 & 2,
If z=0⇒x+y=6 and x+2y=10, ⇒y=4, x=2
If y=0⇒x+z=6 and x+3z=10, ⇒z=2, x=4

So, 3x+2y+λz=μ, must pass through (2,4,0) and (4,0,2).

6+8=μ⇒μ=14
And 12+2λ=μ ⇒λ=1

So, μ-λ2=14-1=13

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
Since, a, b, c & d are in A.P., therefore

b-a=c-b=d-c=λ

We have,

x+a-cx+bx+ax-1x+cx+bx-b+dx+dx+c=2

C2→C2-C3

R2→R2-R1,  R3→R3-R1

⇒-λ4λ2-4λ2-2λ=2

⇒λ2=1

questions.q:
Let S be the set of all integer solutions x, y, z of the system of equations

x-2 y+5 z=0

-2 x+4 y+z=0

-7 x+14 y+9 z=0

such that 15≤x2+y2+z2≤150. Then, the number of elements in the set S is equal to ..........
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
x-2y+5z=0 ...........i

-2x+4y+z=0 ..........ii

-7x+14y+9z=0 ..........iii

Applying 2× equation i+equation ii, we get

z=0

Putting z=0 in equation i, we get

x=2y

Given 15≤x2+y2+z2≤150

⇒15≤4y2+y2≤150

⇒3≤y2≤30

⇒y=±2, ±3, ±4, ±5

⇒8 solutions.
